title: Erratum: small negative rain and snowfall values remain in published files
description: Some physically non-negative precipitation fields contain small negative values. The recent prc/prsn fix stops this in new output, but it does not change files that are already published.
example: The largest negative in the audit sample is about −0.00000355 mm/day. That is tiny for a water budget, but a log transform or strict non-negative QC can still fail. This sample does not bound the worst value in the whole archive.
scientific_evidence: Negative values occur in 18/30 sampled pr files, 20/20 prc and 24/32 prsn. Minimum values are −1.2132×10⁻²³, −4.1111×10⁻¹¹ and −1.1749×10⁻²¹ kg m⁻² s⁻¹ respectively. The largest absolute sampled negative is about 3.55×10⁻⁶ mm/day. These are sample minima, not bounds on the entire archive.
impact: Non-negative-domain algorithms and strict QC can fail. Under ES-DOC’s value-change definition this is High if published values are corrected, although its measured scientific impact and remediation priority are low.
recommended_action: Use the final-result floor for ESM1-6 pr and the existing prc/prsn fixes. Preserve missing values and positive sums even when one component is negative. Quantify full-record counts and total water-mass changes; the present manifest includes only datasets with observed negative samples.
development_team_action: MOPPy: extend the existing final-result nonnegative floor from #855 to ACCESS-ESM1-6 total precipitation pr. Native monthly/daily samples reproduce the published negatives, but do not establish an upstream model-arithmetic defect or a material water-budget error. No atmosphere-team code change is prescribed from these residues alone. Publication team: schedule complete-record incidence and mass-correction checks before reissuing affected versions.
extent_statement: Complete file list within the identified release versions; numerical confirmation was sampled, not a scan of every value.
publication_action: No withdrawal, retraction, replacement or ESGF submission performed by this task.
validation: Six fresh Gadi monthly/daily products reproduce the clipped final native result exactly. The pr fix clears one negative monthly cell and 59 daily cells, preserving every nonnegative value; 102 monthly and 406 daily positive prc sums with a negative component remain unchanged. Three extra writer checks preserve missing input as encoded fill. All 293 selected Gadi tests passed; 16 new pr cases failed on the baseline and passed with the fix.
